result:
Everything looks correct. Here's a summary of all changes made:

**`workflow.py`**
- `"open"` and `"in_progress"` now include `"duplicate"` as a valid next state
- `"duplicate": []` added to `VALID_TRANSITIONS` (no exits — it's terminal)
- `"duplicate"` added to `TERMINAL_STATUSES` (so `ALL_STATUSES` picks it up automatically)
- `mark_duplicate(ticket_id)` convenience function added
- `is_duplicate(ticket)` predicate added (mirrors `is_archived`)

**`core.py`**
- `mark_duplicate_ticket(ticket_id)` added (mirrors `close_ticket`)

**`permissions.py`**
- `"duplicate": {"agent", "admin"}` added — agents can mark duplicates, unlike `"archive"` which is admin-only

**`notifications.py` / `analytics.py`** — no changes needed; both import `TERMINAL_STATUSES` directly, so `"duplicate"` is handled correctly for free (no notifications sent, transitions tracked with `is_terminal: True`).
